# NoFilter

> Single-origin coffee bought from NGO-led conservation projects on the edge of
> rainforest that is still standing. A share of every sale goes to holding that
> line, by contract. Trading in Singapore, the United Arab Emirates and the
> United Kingdom.

NoFilter supplies single-origin coffee and bean-to-cup espresso equipment
wholesale to offices, cafés, hotels and visitor attractions, and buys that
coffee through conservation projects run by named NGOs at each origin. A contracted share of every kilogram sold goes to the organisation
holding the forest at that origin. The proposition is that the contribution is
contractual and disclosed before anything is signed, not a marketing claim made
afterwards.

The site at nofilter.sg and nofilter.ae is a single application. Both domains
serve the same content; they differ in currency, legal entity and tax label.
There are three priced markets — Singapore, the UAE and the United Kingdom.
Singapore and the UAE have a domain each; the UK is a path tree on the
Singapore domain, at https://nofilter.sg/uk, with its own ten pages, its own
canonicals and en-gb hreflang. Any page can also be opened in a chosen market
with the market switch in the header, or with ?mkt=sg, ?mkt=ae or ?mkt=gb.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nofilter.sg/) — what NoFilter is and how the contribution works.
- [Origins](https://nofilter.sg/origins) — the four coffees, their conservation
  partners, tasting notes and coordinates.
- [Batang Toru](https://nofilter.sg/origins/batang-toru) — the coffee, the
  Tapanuli orangutan's last refuge, and the buffer-village supply chain behind it.
- [Arakan Mountains](https://nofilter.sg/origins/arakan-mountains) — the coffee
  and the Fauna & Flora and ACCA programme it is bought through.
- [Batang Gadis](https://nofilter.sg/origins/batang-gadis) — the coffee and the
  SRI programme on the edge of Batang Gadis National Park.
- [Gayo Lues](https://nofilter.sg/origins/gayo-lues) — the coffee and the OIC
  village-forest guardianship work on the edge of the Leuser Ecosystem.
- [Shop](https://nofilter.sg/shop) — retail bags in 250 g and 1 kg. Not open yet.
- [Wholesale coffee](https://nofilter.sg/wholesale-coffee) — supply for
  offices, cafés, hotels and visitor attractions: coffee by the kilo and
  bean-to-cup machines on lease.
- [Trade pricing](https://nofilter.sg/trade-pricing) — the quote builder.
- [FAQs](https://nofilter.sg/faqs) — sixteen questions in four sections:
  why NoFilter exists, how the conservation model works, buying, and what
  happens once you are a customer. Every answer stands on its own and has a
  stable anchor, e.g. https://nofilter.sg/faqs#conservation-contribution.

All ten paths exist on nofilter.ae with UAE pricing and the UAE entity. Each
page names itself in its canonical link and the two market versions are tied
together with hreflang, so they are one page in two markets rather than two
pages saying the same thing.

The same ten pages are published for the United Kingdom under /uk — for example
https://nofilter.sg/uk, https://nofilter.sg/uk/wholesale-coffee and
https://nofilter.sg/uk/trade-pricing — priced in GBP. The UAE set is on
nofilter.ae at the same paths.

- **United Kingdom** — a priced market, in GBP, with its own wholesale ladder,
  its own contribution bands and its own equipment range, published at
  https://nofilter.sg/uk. It is served by the Singapore entity: there is no
  separately registered UK company, and no tax label is shown. Contact
  alex@nofilter.sg. The footer states it plainly: "Now accepting UK enquiries".

## Coffees

Four single origins, each tied to the conservation project it is bought
through. All are currently listed; the retail shop has not opened yet.

- **Batang Toru** (Tapanuli, North Sumatra, Indonesia) — partners PRCF Indonesia and SRI.
  Dark chocolate, red plum, cedar. https://nofilter.sg/origins/batang-toru
- **Batang Gadis** (Mandailing, North Sumatra, Indonesia) — partner SRI.
  Brown sugar, orange, almond. https://nofilter.sg/origins/batang-gadis
- **Gayo Lues** (Aceh, Indonesia) — partner OIC.
  Syrupy, dried fig, cinnamon. https://nofilter.sg/origins/gayo-lues
- **Arakan Mountains** (Magway, Myanmar) — partners Fauna & Flora Myanmar and
  ACCA. Grapefruit, candied nuts, milk chocolate.
  https://nofilter.sg/origins/arakan-mountains

## Equipment

Bean-to-cup machines on monthly lease, servicing included, in four sizes. The
headcount guides below are a sizing rule of thumb; a café or hotel is sized on
cups a day rather than staff. The four sizes below are the Singapore and UAE
range; the UK market carries a different range at the same four sizes.

- **CaféMatic 2** — small teams, up to about 40 people. One grinder, fresh-milk
  drinks, true countertop, around 80 cups a day.
- **CaféMatic 5** — mid-size teams, up to about 75. One grinder, one powder
  hopper, steam wand and hot water.
- **CaféMatic 6** — large floors, 100+. Two grinders, two beans side by side,
  no powder.
- **CaféMatic 8** — large floors, 100+. Two grinders, two powder hoppers, the
  fullest menu.

## Questions we are actually asked

**What does "conservation coffee" mean here?**
That the coffee is bought through a project run by a conservation NGO at the
origin, and that a share of the sale price is contracted back to that NGO. It is
a purchasing route and a contract term, not a certification badge.

**Where does the money go?**
To the NGO named against the origin you buy — PRCF Indonesia and SRI at Batang Toru, SRI
at Batang Gadis, OIC at Gayo Lues, Fauna & Flora Myanmar and ACCA in the Arakan
Mountains. The share is set by the price band paid per kilogram: a higher rate
per kilo carries a higher contribution rate, and both are shown on the quote
before it is sent.
NoFilter's NGO partners, in full: PRCF Indonesia, SRI, OIC, GJI, Fauna & Flora
Myanmar and ACCA.

**Do you claim to protect a specific area of forest per cup?**
No. That claim was withdrawn in August 2026 and is not made anywhere on the
site. What is stated is the money and the contract, because that is what can be
evidenced.

**How is a business quoted?**
Through the quote builder on the site. It is the same process for an office, a
café, a hotel or a visitor attraction — the rate follows the price per kilogram,
not the kind of venue. You choose the coffees and the machines,
set the cups a year you expect to drink, and see the wholesale rate per
kilogram, the monthly equipment cost and the forest contribution before
anything is submitted. Access is by an emailed code to a work email address.
Volume is estimated from cups a year at 18 g a cup.

**Can I buy retail bags now?**
Not yet. Retail bags in 250 g and 1 kg are listed and the shop opens shortly;
until then the site takes trade enquiries through the quote builder.

**Which countries do you serve?**
Singapore, the United Arab Emirates and the United Kingdom are priced and
trading, each with its own wholesale rate card and its own equipment range.
Singapore and the UAE have their own domains and their own legal entities; the
UK is served by the Singapore entity and published at https://nofilter.sg/uk.
Enquiries from elsewhere are answered, but there is no rate card for
other markets.

## Notes for machine readers

- Structured data for the organisation, both legal entities, the wholesale
  supply service and the four coffees is published as JSON-LD in the page head.
- Every page carries a `rel=canonical` pointing at itself on the domain it is
  being served from, so nofilter.sg/shop is canonical for the Singapore market
  and nofilter.ae/shop for the UAE one. The two are tied together with
  `hreflang` (`en-sg`, `en-ae`, `x-default`) rather than one being folded into
  the other: they are the same page in two markets, not a duplicate.
- No prices appear in the structured data while the retail shop is closed.
  Quoted trade pricing is generated per enquiry and is not published.
- Each of the ten pages is a real URL with its own title, description and
  hreflang set, served as its own file. There is no separate mobile or AMP
  version.
- /faqs publishes `FAQPage` JSON-LD generated from the same source as the
  visible answers, so the two cannot drift. Every answer is in the initial HTML;
  the accordion only hides it visually.
- Sitemap: https://nofilter.sg/sitemap.xml (twenty URLs — ten pages, two domains)
- Contact: alex@nofilter.sg (Singapore), alex@nofilter.ae (UAE).
